title: willughbeiopsis beccarii

This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Papua New Guinea, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Willughbeiopsis beccarii include wound healing, fever reduction, and the treatment of various infections.
